title: workspace init
description: Stdout of `workspace init --code CODE [--remote URL] --json`: the workspace that was created, or that already existed at the root; with --remote also the remote it was bound to.

workspace_id.description: Id of the workspace, from its workspace.json.

device_id.description: Id of this machine's device file.

created.description: Whether this call created the workspace.

already_initialized.description: Whether the root already held this workspace; always the opposite of `created`.

remote.description: The remote the workspace was bound to as origin; present only when --remote was given.

url.description: The remote URL without user information.

classification.description: What the remote held: empty (no branch) or the same workspace.

next.description: The command to run next (the first push); present only when --remote was given.
